summary: 22 of 26 sub-steps present. The four absent are L1 (no residual table or per-edge dimensions), L2 (only the t_X perp t_Y label inclusion; no complement or h-2), L4 (orthonormal basis used as a given; no nondegenerate/nonalternating argument) and P3 (no k-column tensoring of each residual kernel). P1 and P4 are present but borderline: P1 lacks the explicit sum formula for q_V-q_U, and P4 lacks the separate zero/full-label frame statement and the explicit X-output negation.
